Volume estimation and peak discharge (processing data from 2 radar stage sensors along the channel, using the velocities of all the surges)
Seismic network (linear array of three 10-Hz geophones made by Geospace Technologies)

Geophone dataset is composed of converted original ascii files digitized by SIAP+MICROS (sampling rate = 128 Hz, the system only stores the amplitude evenvelope) to miniseed files, applied corrections to physical units (m/s).
Raw waveforms from closest stations. Data was demeaned but no other processing was applied. Figure generation is automated and there may be artifacts present.
